summary: Literature analysis reveals the paper (Rabinovich 2014, Prop 3.5/Cor 5.4) constructs bracket witnesses IN ORDER via nested Until formulas, never facing the batch-ordering problem. The correct Lean encoding is per-SSN bounded Until formulas (conjunction approach), not a flat BracketFormula. Each positive between_tx SSN gets: seg_guard Until (char_y(ssn_i) AND (seg_guard Until char_1(nf_x))), which independently bounds each witness to (t,x). This eliminates all ordering issues and avoids the nf_y_proj injectivity gap.
